TRAINER.heading: Meet the Mind Behind the Transformation
TRAINER.name: Dipen Ghatalia (DG)
TRAINER.title: DG Trainings — Power to Performance · Brand & Management Consultant
TRAINER.headline: 25+ years of business wisdom. 17 years of turning teams into forces.
bio: Dipen Ghatalia has spent more than 25 years inside businesses — as a brand consultant, management consultant, marketer and natural copywriter. For the last 17 of those years, he has channelled that experience into one mission: helping people and teams perform at their very best.

With experience across retail, wholesale and manufacturing, he works with business leaders and teams to strengthen workplace culture, management practices and professional capability. He has partnered with 100+ entrepreneurs and trained more than 35,000 professionals across 20 cities and 3 countries.
His gift is culture. DG builds workplaces where energy is high, ownership is natural and growth becomes unstoppable — and his sessions are remembered long after the training room empties.
TRAINER.quote: A trained team doesn’t just sell more. It believes more, owns more and grows more.
expertise: 20 cities across 3 countries — national and global experience
Dedicated to the jewellery industry since 2011
Deep expertise across retail, wholesale and manufacturing

faqs: Will you give us scripts?
Yes — and we tailor them to your brand, offers and customers, so they sound natural, not read.

Yes. Any team member who calls customers will benefit — especially for festive and wedding seasons.
How do we know it worked?
We set up a simple before/after tracker so you can see the change in visits and callbacks.
